faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Madras Project Associate-II posts is 27th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Project Associate-II position at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in physics/electrical engineering or a Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or technology or physics, along with 2 years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 35,000/- +30% HRA or Rs. 28,000/- +30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Madras Project Associate-II posts?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official IIT Madras website.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Shortlisting, Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of IIT Madras for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is ICSR/PR/Advt.189/2026.
